meta.description: The assessment framework as one built page. Every section a component page carries, filled with sample data: a tappable tile with a slotted icon, a title, a description and an optional badge that exists nowhere in Figma.

verdict.title: Fix — three findings to close
verdict.text: The icon container is not a Slot (C1), no loading state is built (C5), and the badge is drawn locally (C6). Sample data — nothing on this page was read from Figma.

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Carries any title, description and icon without knowing what service it stands for; the same tile serves a catalog, a settings list or a dashboard.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Owns its container, spacing and text styles; every fill is bound to a main/sample/color/… token, so nothing depends on the screen behind it.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: Style, State and Size are PascalCase with Title Case values per §1 and §5, but the trailing badge is drawn inside the component rather than instanced from the shared Badge, so its styling can drift from the rest of the system.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: IconContainer holds a fixed Placeholder instance instead of a Figma Slot; a consumer detaches to swap the artwork, and native hand-off has no content slot to bind.

behavior.notes: Resting tile — all content visible, badge shown when hasBadge.
Background darkens (Filled) or tints (Outlined) for the duration of the touch.
Text and icon dimmed; taps ignored. Used for a service that is temporarily unavailable.
No skeleton or spinner treatment exists in the set — consumers hide the tile while data loads. Raises C5.

resolved.headline: state renamed to State with Title Case values.
resolved.body: v1.1: default | pressed | disabled became Default | Pressed | Disabled per §1 and §5, so a generated enum reads the same as the Figma panel. (C2 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Pressed built at both sizes.
resolved.body: v1.1: The set gained State=Pressed for Medium and Small, closing half of the state-coverage finding. Loading is still open below. (C5)

resolved.headline: Colours bound to semantic tokens.
resolved.body: v1.2: Every fill and text colour resolves to a main/sample/color/{style}/{state}/{role} variable; no raw hex remains on the tile. (C3 · Token)

open.headline: The icon container is not a Figma Slot.
open.body: IconContainer on 1234:5679 holds a fixed Placeholder instance. A consumer must detach the tile to swap the artwork, and native hand-off has no slot to bind. Convert it to a Slot with the placeholder as the swap target.

open.headline: No loading treatment is built.
open.body: The set covers Default, Pressed and Disabled at both sizes but has no skeleton or spinner. A tile that waits on data has nothing to show, so every consumer improvises. Add a Status=Skeleton axis, as Generic Card does.

open.headline: The badge is drawn locally.
open.body: The trailing pill is a rectangle and a text layer inside the component rather than an instance of the shared Badge, so a Badge change does not reach it and its colours are bound separately. Instance the shared component.

recommendations.headline: Convert IconContainer to a Figma Slot.
recommendations.body: Keep the Placeholder instance as the swap target so the default render is unchanged; consumers then swap without detaching and the native API gets a real icon slot.

recommendations.headline: Instance the shared Badge for the trailing pill.
recommendations.body: Replace the local rectangle and text with a Badge instance at its Small Caption size; drop the two local badge tokens once it inherits the Badge colours.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Rename state to State with Title Case values.
appliedRecommendations.body: Applied in v1.1 — the three values now match the §5 vocabulary and the generated enum.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Filled for the one featured tile on a screen.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t stack two Filled tiles — the emphasis cancels out.

usageGuidelines.doText: Keep the Title to one line; the tile truncates with an ellipsis.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t put a price or a count in the Description — that is what the badge is for.

usageGuidelines.doText: Swap Icon-Slot for the service’s own 24 px icon.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t ship the star placeholder to production.

scorecard.notes: Frames PascalCase on 1234:5679. IconContainer holds a fixed Placeholder instance rather than a Figma Slot, so consumers detach to swap artwork.
Style, State and Size PascalCase with Title Case values; hasBadge follows the boolean convention.
Every fill is bound to main/sample/color/…; Title resolves to Primary/Label/Large, Description to Secondary/Bold/Caption, Badge to Secondary/Bold/Small Caption.
Two enums, one boolean, two text values and one slot — maps 1:1 onto EBSampleComponent.
Default, Pressed and Disabled built at both sizes; no loading treatment exists in the set.
The icon is a vector placeholder; the trailing badge is drawn locally rather than instanced from the shared Badge.

variants.collapseLabel: View full Style × State × Size breakdown (12 rows)

rows.body: Every section of the framework, on sample data. Header, Overview, Style, Code and Changelog written in the target shape so the assessment can be seen whole. Nothing on this page was read from Figma; the set, its nodes and every value are invented.

Style tab as Examples. One card per Figma property — Style, State, Size, hasBadge — each drawing every value of its property with the other properties in its panel, and carrying only the sections that property changes; the inventory lists all 12 nodes with a summary and a collapsed breakdown.

changelog.header: Colours bound to semantic tokens · node 1234:5678

rows.body: Every fill and text colour bound to main/sample/color/{style}/{state}/{role}. The raw hex values flagged in 1.0.0 are gone from the tile; the colors table now carries a token on every row.
Badge still drawn locally. The two badge tokens were bound with the rest, but the pill remains a rectangle and a text layer rather than a Badge instance.

changelog.header: State axis renamed and Pressed added · node 1234:5678

rows.body: state → State, values Title Case. Default | Pressed | Disabled per §1 and §5; the generated enum now reads like the panel.
Pressed built at Medium and Small. The set grew from 8 to 12 variants; the pressed fills are #0047B3 (Filled) and #F6F9FD (Outlined).
Recommendation applied: Rename state to State with Title Case values — moved to Applied.
Loading still not built. Pressed closes half of the C5 finding; a skeleton or spinner treatment is still missing.
Verdict: Fix — belongs in the system; four findings block native hand-off.
C1 — Icon container is not a Slot. Consumers detach to swap the artwork.
C3 — Raw hex fills. Background, text and badge colours are unbound.
C5 — Pressed and Loading missing. Only Default and Disabled are built.
C6 — Local badge. The trailing pill is drawn inside the component.
